senses.gloss: गय m. 1. Name of the people living round Gayā and the district inhabited by them; 2. name of an Asura.
गया f. Name of a city in Bīhār which is a place of pilgrimage.
गाय m. Singing, a song, Yaj.iii.112.
गायक m. A singer, a musician, न नटा न विटा न गायकाः (v.l. for गायनाः), Bhartr.iii.27.
गायत्र m. A song, a hymn.

गायत्री f. 1. A vedic metre of twenty-four syllables, गायत्री छंदसामहम् Bg.x.35; 2. hymn composed in that metre; 3. a particular verse written in that metre, held specially sacred and repeated by every Brāhmaṇa at his morning and evening devotion. (It is this- तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि । धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् Rv.iii.62, 10).
गायत्रिन् a. (f. णी) One who sings hymns especially of the Sāmaveda.
गायत्रिन् a. (f. णी) One who sings hymns especially of the Sāmaveda.
गायन (I) m. (fem. नी) A singer, Bhartr.iii.27.
गायन (II) n. 1. Singing, a song; 2. practising singing as a profession.
